# azion_bucket (Resource)

Resource for managing Azion Storage Buckets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "azion_bucket" "example" {
  bucket {
    name             = "my-bucket-name"
    workloads_access = "read_write"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bucket` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--bucket))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last Terraform update of the resource.

<a id="nestedblock--bucket"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bucket`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the bucket. This field is immutable and cannot be updated after creation.
- `workloads_access` (String) Access type for workloads: read_only, read_write, or restricted.

Read-Only:

- `last_editor` (String) The last editor of the bucket.
- `last_modified` (String) Last modified timestamp of the bucket.
- `product_version` (String) Product version of the bucket.
